reasoning: The document has multiple major defects, including severe visual duplication where tabular data is presented both as HTML tables and as image screenshots immediately following. Additionally, the Table of Contents is significantly truncated, and 97 header/footer elements were incorrectly retained in the output. These issues mandate human review to correct structural and content problems.

concerns.description: Significant text omission within a section
concerns.analysis: Examined the Table of Contents on page 2. The output JSON abruptly truncates the list after 'Table 2 - 2024 Study Group ....... 7'. All subsequent Table of Contents entries (from Section 2 to the Appendix) are entirely missing from the output.

In the sections covering the FY 2021-2022 and FY 2022-2023 financial reports, the data tables are correctly extracted and rendered as HTML `` elements. However, immediately following these HTML tables, there are `` elements containing screenshots of the exact same financial tables from the source PDF. This results in the tabular data being displayed twice consecutively to the user (once as text, once as an image).
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Pages 30-31 display the financial tables for FY 2021-2022 and FY 2022-2023.
concerns.output_quote: The HTML renders the tables as text and then includes duplicate images such as ``.

concerns.description: Text formatting not preserved (bold, italic, underline)
concerns.analysis: While italic formatting is largely preserved (e.g., 'et seq.', document titles), the bold formatting that visually indicates headers within the Goal tables (pages 33-42) has been lost. In the source document, text like 'GOAL 1' and the column labels 'Objective', 'Description', and 'Ownership' are bold to structure the table. In the HTML, these are rendered as plain `<td>` elements without bold styling or `<th>` tags, removing the visual emphasis and structural meaning.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: On page 33, within the table, the text 'GOAL 1', 'Run and manage the Statewide hosted Next Generation 911 system.', 'Objective', 'Description', and 'Ownership' are bold.
concerns.output_quote: The HTML renders these cells without bold or header tags: `GOAL 1...ObjectiveDescriptionOwnership`.

concerns.description: Table caption coded as header row: 7 table(s) have a single spanning first row that is likely a caption/title
concerns.analysis: caption_as_header=7. Examples: p34: "GOAL 1"; p36: "GOAL 3"; p38: "GOAL 5". First row spans all columns — should be a <caption> element, not a header row.

concerns.description: Displaced hyperlinks: 3 link(s) extracted as standalone elements instead of inline text
concerns.analysis: standalone_links=3, examples=['https://www.census.gov/data/tables/time-series/demo/popest/2', 'https://it.nc.gov/about/boards-commissions/911-board/about-n', 'https://it.nc.gov/about/board-commissions/911-board-fund']. Links should be inline within paragraphs, not separate blocks.

concerns.description: Header/footer elements retained in output (97): North Carolina 2024 State 911 Plan – Approved 12/01/2023; North Carolina 2024 State 911 Plan – Approved 12/01/2023; 2 | Page
concerns.analysis: header_footer_count=97. Running headers/footers/page numbers should be stripped during PDF-to-HTML conversion.

While footnotes are captured, Footnote 11 at the bottom of PDF page 27 was improperly merged with the continuation of the main body paragraph at the top of PDF page 28. This resulted in the footnote text and the main body text being concatenated into a single unbroken paragraph.
concerns.source_pdf_quote: Footnote at bottom of PDF page 27: "11 National Emergency Number Association... p 8.". Main body text at top of PDF page 28: "stress resilience plans empowering their personnel..."
concerns.output_quote: "11 National Emergency Number Association, NENA Standard on 911 Acute/Traumatic and Chronic Stress Management, NENA-STA-002.1-2013, August 5, 201, p 8. stress resilience plans empowering their personnel for wellness by preventing, managing, and healing from these impacts."

concerns.description: Repeated footer/header text (2x): "*(remainder of page is blank)*"
concerns.analysis: Short text with footer-like pattern appears on 2 pages

concerns.description: Numbered items as headings: 5 heading(s) look like numbered list items
concerns.analysis: heading_list_count=5. Headings starting with '1.', '2.' etc. suggest numbered list items were misclassified as headings during extraction.

concerns.description: Unrendered markdown formatting: 0 bold (**text**) and 14 italic (*text*) instances — e.g. *et seq.*; *the 911 Board: About the NC 911 Board*; *et seq.*
concerns.analysis: markdown_bold=0, markdown_italic=14. Gemini markdown syntax left as literal asterisks instead of being converted to HTML <strong>/<em> tags.

action_items: Remove duplicated image screenshots of data tables where HTML tables already exist.
Restore the missing Table of Contents entries.
Strip all running headers, footers, and page numbers from the HTML output.
Convert spanning first rows in Goal tables to proper <caption> tags.
Reintegrate standalone hyperlinks into their correct inline paragraph locations.
Reapply necessary bold styling or <th> tags to table headers in the Goal tables.
